notes: Route: robots.txt (status 200) is permissive - only /free, /profile, /search disallowed, Crawl-delay 1, no Sitemap lines. But https://www.1tv.ru/sitemap.xml (200) is a sitemapindex with per-year news sitemaps; sitemap-news-2026.xml (200, 4.8 MB) is ONE flat urlset of ~26k article URLs shaped https://www.1tv.ru/news/YYYY-MM-DD/<id>, i.e. the publication date is embedded in the URL path. 2826 URLs fall in 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, every day 66-113 (min 66, requirement 15). Date source: the URL path date - verified it equals the date shown on the article page (span.PlayerBlockHeading_date, Russian month names): /news/2026-09-30/554659 shows '30 сентября 2026, 12:55', /news/2026-10-20/556551 shows '20 октября 2026, 09:09', plus 4 more random samples across 10-02..10-24 all matching. The sitemap <lastmod> is edit time (minutes after publish, e.g. 09:09 -> 09:34), so it is not used. /rss is an HTML page, not a feed; no WP REST (site is Next.js). Script = 1 request, ~36 s, writes sorted unique TSV URL<TAB>date. Verified: 0 duplicate URLs, all dates in window, 4 random re-fetched articles each 200 with 100k+ stripped chars (body paragraphs far exceed 1500) and page date == listed date.
